## Overview

Inventory all issue templates and standardise status, purpose, and mapping signals.

## In-Scope

- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.md`
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`

## Audit Checklist

- [ ] Template inventory complete
- [ ] Template status recorded (active/deprecated)
- [ ] Required metadata/frontmatter fields verified
- [ ] Template-to-type alignment checked

## Deliverables

- Template inventory matrix (name, type, status, used, notes)
- Gap list with recommendations
